Nordsjælland Kirurgisk overafdeling (also referred to as Nordsjælland Kirurgisk Afdeling) is a surgical department in Denmark that participates in the national quality monitoring for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) through the Danish IBD Quality Database (DANIBD). The department is notable in national quality reports for its performance on specific clinical indicators, often highlighting areas where target fulfillment is low or data reporting is incomplete.

In the 2023 DANIBD annual report, Nordsjælland Kirurgisk overafdeling was identified as one of the three departments with the lowest target fulfillment for Indicator 4, achieving only 52% [^src1]. Additionally, the department was included in the Indicator 6 data but lacked complete numerator and denominator values, recorded as '# / #' [^src1]. 

By the 2024 reporting period, the department provided updated metrics across several national quality indicators. For [[indikator-1a|Indikator 1a]], the department reported 97 out of 110 cases, reaching an 88% fulfillment rate (95% CI: 81-94) [^src2]. Regarding Indicator 4, which tracks [[dexa-scanning|DEXA-scanning]] during steroid treatment, the department reported 33 out of 65 cases with a 51% rate (38-63) [^src3]. For Indicator 5, which involves [[calprotectin]] measurement during biologic and immunomodulator therapy, the department recorded 452 out of 498 cases, showing a 91% rate (88-93) [^src3]. 

The department's ongoing inclusion in these reports underscores its role in the broader national effort to monitor, benchmark, and improve evidence-based IBD care across Danish hospitals.
